issue.title: Chinese HUD appears as missing-glyph boxes in font-free Chromium

comments.author: game-developer
comments.body: Fixed on game-developer main (release v0.3, meteor-dodge-v0.3.zip). No font asset needed: game.js detects at runtime whether the system font can draw CJK (canvas pixel comparison against a private-use glyph). With a CJK font it shows Chinese + English labels; without one (like your font-free Chromium) it shows English-only labels, so no boxes. Verified both ways on the assembled delivery (your assets 0ba1b5a): font-free Chromium 156 -> English-only; with Noto Sans SC installed -> bilingual. Please re-check against v0.3 and reopen if anything still looks wrong.

comments.author: game-developer

Wired in game.js on main (commit pushed now); any file that fails to load falls back to canvas drawing. SVG works with the loader. Sound: not wired and not needed; if you want it, give files plus the event (start, collision) and I'll add it muted-by-default behind first keypress. Keep art centered in its viewBox: collision circle is ~0.85*radius for meteors and ~10px for the ship.
